description: Extract and analyze device firmware to find hardcoded secrets, backdoors, vulnerable services, and the real version behind an appliance. Load when you have a firmware image or can pull one. Signals: a .bin/.img firmware download, a router/IoT/appliance in scope, an OTA update file, a flash dump, "analyze this firmware", SquashFS/JFFS2/CramFS, U-Boot headers, hunting the code behind a CVE on FortiGate/Ivanti/etc.
